description: We are seeking a Clinical Administrator to join our Clinical Administration Team. Promoting effectiveness and efficiency, acting as a resource for clinical staff, patients, their families, visitors and volunteers. To be the main point of contact for administrative matters. (NB. Liaise between the patients, families and Myton clinicians in an efficient manner when needed. This may include ensuring the Welcome Pack is available together with information relating to Myton Services, the option for patients and families to use their private medical insurance if wished, this must be discussed with a member of the nursing team. Maintain patient notes trolley ensuring notes are tidy and accessible and returning other external health care professional notes in a confidential manner following discharge. Update Clinical Noticeboards, Ward Diary and IPU Folders including Policy Folders; EMIS User Guides; Instructions when requested. Monitor stock levels, re-order clinical documentation and leaflets as needed. Liaise with volunteers to ensure clinical information packs are maintained.
